title: Additive manufacturing of dense WE43 Mg alloy by laser powder bed fusion (Hyer et al., Additive Manufacturing, 2020)
publisher: Oak Ridge National Laboratory publication record; Elsevier journal, DOI 10.1016/j.addma.2020.101123

rights.attribution: H. Hyer, L. Zhou, G. Benson, B. McWilliams, K. Cho, Y. Sohn

notes: Abstract read on the ORNL record: over 99 % relative density at 200 W, 1100 mm/s, 0.13 mm hatch, 0.03 mm layer. As-built tensile yield 215 MPa, UTS 251 MPa, 2.6 % strain; after 536 C/24 h solutionizing and 205 C/48 h ageing, yield 219 MPa, UTS 251 MPa, 4.3 %. Room-temperature coupon data from one laboratory; not a hot, fatigue, notched or rotating allowable.
